notes.title: CORR & Spelkollektivet.
notes.content:
Hi, Dani here, letting you all know that we're not dead! 🥳🎉
That’s right, we are still kicking! It's been a while since our last update on CORR, so I figured today was as good a day as any—especially since it's a special one! But first, I thought it was about time that we mentioned that...

 We're getting published by Spelkollektivet! 🥳🎉 
Perhaps not very interesting news, (if we can even call it news at this point, considering we "signed" over a year ago—yes, we’re slow with updates, sorry! ːsteamfacepalmː). 

Now, I could go into details about what it means to develop a game at Spelkollektivet, but I won't because today...

 A documentary about Spelkollektivet is out and free to watch on youtube! 🥳🎉 
 
[previewyoutube=Y4oBSm3QJk4;full][/previewyoutube]
Yeah, why go into details when there’s an amazing documentary about Spelkollektivet made by the talented Jonathan Duek?! ¯\_(ツ)_/¯

notes.title: SHMUP FEST UPDATES
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It's been a while since our last update, but I can assure you that we're still alive and have been hard at work! A lot has happened since we launched the Steam page, and because we're only two people on the team, it has been difficult for us to keep up with posting updates without also completely halting production at the same time. 

As mentioned earlier, a lot has happened in the meantime, and in the spirit of SHMUP FEST, expect to  see updates, development posts and announcements peppered throughout the week. 

If you haven't already, make sure to follow CORR on Steam so you won't miss out on any of the updates here. :)

Of course, I can't just end this post with no juicy visuals, so if you haven't already seen it back when we posted it on Twitter, (X?), here's a character that will be assisting you.

notes.title: Dev Journal 1# - The Journey Begins!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! I’m Dani Felix and I’m 50% of Go Go Galago Games!

Today we finally published our Steam page, complete with an announcement trailer! 

[previewyoutube=xAOTmZggdcg;full][/previewyoutube]

This doesn’t seem like a huge accomplishment in the grand scheme of things, but to us it feels like a major milestone. At the same time, it also feels so very weird and scary because we’re so far from launch. I mean, imagine a painter having to show his painting to the world while there is at minimum a year left of painting, (well I guess commissioned painters do that… hmmm, perhaps it’s not the best analogy, but yeah, it still feels weird).

But It’s also very exciting! See, we want to make the best boss rush game the world has ever seen, which, yeah, that’s kind of ambitious for such a small team, but you gotta set some goals for yourself, am I right? And why go out to make the 2nd or 3rd best of something? Nah, that just ain’t gonna cut it.

The point I’m making here is that to make the best boss rush game ever, we’re gonna need the help from all of you. We’d love to hear all your feedback and critique as we continue to show more of the game. Soon we’ll have a demo out for all of you to play too. Currently, we’re a bit apprehensive about Early Access, but there will absolutely be several betas across development.

Question: Where is your Discord Server!?
- Well, we’re just two people, so right now we want to take one step at a time. There is a lot of work that goes into maintaining a Discord server, and we don’t want to let anyone down. As soon as we feel confident that we’ll be able to take on that task, we’ll open the Discord server so keep an eye out for news about that. For now, if you want to let us know what you think of the project so far, you can do that by going to the Community Hub and make a post at the discussion forums. We’d love to hear all your thoughts!

Yeah, I think that’s all I had to say for now.

Make sure to follow the project to receive updates on CORR here, (oh, and Wishlist the game of course 😉! Share it with all your friends, neighbors, communities! All that stuff!). Again, we should have a demo out very soon, so definitely keep an eye out for that!

Have a wonderful week y’all!
